$comment: DDS pre-render config for mermaid-cli (mmdc). Produces light-theme static SVG matching dexter.css tokens. Usage: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i diagram.mmd -o diagram.svg --configFile mermaid-config.json --backgroundColor transparent. Pre-rendered SVG is single-theme by nature — use for final/emailed/self-contained documents; use dds-mermaid.js for hosted, theme-adaptive pages. Keep in sync with dds-mermaid.js LIGHT block.
fontFamily: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, system-ui, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
